annotation.bound_parties_text: The Act imposes requirements on personal delivery devices and the entities that operate them (personal delivery device operators), and allows local governments to prohibit such devices.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: An entity that operates a personal delivery device must maintain an insurance policy that includes general liability coverage of not less than one hundred thousand
annotation.dates_quote: SECTION 6. This act shall take effect July 1, 2020, the public welfare requiring it.
